0|0fb39bbe43d4481fcf300d2b5822de60942fd189|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"netfilter: nf_tables: don't skip inactive chains during update
There is no synchronization between packet path and the configuration plane.
The packet path uses two arrays with rules
generation.  The other either contains the last (obsolete) generation or
the future one.
Consider:
cpu1               cpu2
nft_do_chain(c);
delete c
net->gen++;
genbit = !!net->gen;
rules = c->rg[genbit];
cpu1 ignores c when updating if c is not active anymore in the new
generation.
On cpu2
column2: we now use rules from wrong generation

column1: contains the rules matching 'c' whereas c->rg[new] was not updated and
can even point to rules that have been free'd already
To fix this
column2: make sure that 'current' to the 'next' generation are

column1: identical for chains that are going away so that c->rg[new] will just
use the matching rules even if genbit was incremented already.
Fixes: 0cbc06b3faba7 (""netfilter: nf_tables: remove synchronize_rcu in commit phase"")
